    assert p['measurements']==read('overslip-proposal')['measurements'],'Review new measurement before spending.'
    return a,p

    fetch=panel._fetch;index=0
    def wrapped(req,timeout=None):
        nonlocal index

        index+=1;stem=f'{stage}-http-{index:03}'
        assert not (ROOT/(stem+'.json')).exists(),'Never overwrite a completed HTTP call.'
        record={'started_at':now(),'sequence':index,'url':req.full_url,
                'request_body':json.loads(req.data),'timeout_s':timeout}
        save(stem,record);start=time.monotonic()
        try:
            result=fetch(req,timeout);record['response']=result;return result
        except BaseException as exc:
            record['exception']={'class':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)};raise
        finally:
            record['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start;record['finished_at']=now();save(stem,record)
            if index%8==0:print('RECORDED',stage,index,flush=True)
    panel._fetch=wrapped
